newsitem.title: TUNISIA: SOCCER-WEAH MISSES OUT ON WORLD CUP AS LIBERIA LOSE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH MISSES OUT ON WORLD CUP AS LIBERIA LOSE.

text.p: A.C. Milan striker George Weah saw his dreams of playing in next year's World Cup finals in France ended on Sunday as Liberia crashed 2-0 in a qualifier against Tunisia.

Weah, world player of the year in 1995, has bankrolled his country's bid for a place in the finals but was powerless to stop the well-organised Tunisians stretching their lead at the top of African group two to six points over Egypt.
Tunisia, beaten finalists in the Africa Nations' Cup last year, now need one point from their last two games against Egypt and Namibia to secure their place in France. Weah's Liberia cannot qualify.

Adel Sellimi, who plays for French first division Nantes, won a penalty in the 60th minute and converted it himself to put the Tunisians ahead. Twelve minutes from time, Khaled Badra added the second.
Weah's side, which included eight European-based players, caused few problems for a confident home team boosted by a 38,000 crowd.
